title: Spectral Rigidity in Toroidal Grothendieck Rings and Multiparameter Quantum Groups
summary: Let $Q$ be a bipartite Dynkin quiver of finite simply-laced type and $\mathscr C_Q$ the corresponding Hernandez--Leclerc category. We study a two-parameter specialization of the Fedele--Hernandez toroidal Grothendieck ring and identify its generic positive part with a Cartan-type multiparameter quantum group. The structural input is the identity \[ 2D^{(2)}-D_0=ω_Q\circ(°_Q,°_Q), \] where $D_0,D^{(2)}$ are the two effective toroidal commutation forms and $ω_Q$ is the antisymmetric Euler form of \(Q\).
